title: Bolder Adventure Park Base Camp Pass
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Bolder Adventure Park is 66,000 square feet of non-stop indoor adventure in the heart of DFW, built inside a one-of-a-kind air-supported dome with ceilings up to 75 feet — fully climate-controlled and open rain or shine. Race down four stories of real snow tubes on the Tubing Slides, scramble through the sky-high treehouses and giant ball pit of Adventure Nets, battle it out in the Blaster Zone, explore three stories of play in the Exploration Playground, bounce on the giant Jump Pad, and spin out on the Spin Zone Bumper Cars. Craving more? Upgrade to All Access for indoor via ferrata, a ropes course with zip lines, rock climbing, free fall, and archery — making Bolder a full day of adventure unlike anywhere else in Texas.
